description: PAID tool, run by Ego Agent. Before a trade on Arc: is this pool safe to trade in right now, how far would this amount move the price, and how much may one trade carry. Measured from the pool on chain at the moment of the call. Payment is x402 over MCP in USDC on Arc: call it without a payment to be told the price and where to pay; call it again with the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"] to get the answer. You are charged only when the answer is delivered.

market.description: The token traded against USDC: BTC, ETH or EURC.

side.description: buy = USDC to the token (default), sell = the token to USDC.

usdc.description: The size of the trade, in USDC.

name: trade_check
title: Trade Check (paid, 0.01 USDC)
